name: Ramiz Alia
wd_description: former First Secretary of the Party of Labour of Albania, 1st President of the Republic of Albania (1925-2011)
positions: First Secretary of the Party of Labor of Albania
extract: Ramiz Alia (Albanian pronunciation: [ɾaˈmiz aˈlia] ; 18 October 1925 – 7 October 2011) was an Albanian politician serving as the second and last leader of the People's Socialist Republic of Albania from 1985 to 1991, serving as First Secretary of the Party of Labour of Albania. He was also the country's head of state from 1982 to 1992. He had been seen as a successor by Enver Hoxha and took power after Hoxha died.
wp_description: Head of state of Albania from 1982 to 1992
